title: Promo Financing Results
description: Details of the special financing offer returned from the issuer.

promoFinancingType.description: Type of special financing information provided. * `PROMO_APR ` - APR information provided only for the duration of the promo period; * `PROMO_AND_AFTER_APR ` - APR information provided for the duration of and after the promo period; * `PROMO_AND_AFTER_APR ` - No promotional financing available; * `ERROR ` - error.

promoAnnualPercentageRateType.description: The type of APR applicable during promo period.

promoAnnualPercentageRate.description: The interest rate expressed in Annual Percentage Rate (APR), applicable during the promo period.

annualPercentageRateType.description: The type of APR applicable after promo period.

annualPercentageRate.description: The interest rate expressed in Annual Percentage Rate (APR).

promoDurationDescription.description: Information or description of the promo period duration, e.g. 6 months

promoDescription.description: Description of the promotional financing plan.
